product_metadata.title: KMAT Bathroom Rugs and Mats Sets,2 PCS Ultra Soft Microfiber Non-Slip Bath mat,Machine Washable Shower Rugs Floor Carpet Mat for Bathroom,Tub and Shower (59"x20"+26"x18", Dark Grey)
features: [Ultra Soft & Versatile]: KMAT luxury bathroom rugs are made of premium microfiber material which is heavy-duty and comfortable. This ultra soft bath mat makesyou feel warm and cozy underfoot to protect your feet from the cold floor after your taking bath or shower. Our bathroom rug set includes 2 pack(18"x26"+20"x59"). Perfect for bedroom, bathroom, vanity，living room, mud room, entryways, hotels, feet-spa club, and by bathtub and sink.

[Keep Your Floors Dry]: Our bathroom shower rug is super absorbent, helping absorb the moisture from your feet quickly and lock the moisture in the carpet efficiently to keep your room floor dry and clean. KMAT bathroom rugs is a good life assist to reduce worry on wet floors and always keep your home tidy and clean.

[Strong Non Skid Backing]: The bottom of the shower rug is made of TP rubber which is skid resistant,non-toxic and could keep in place well.Its unique design provides a fashionable accent to any area within the home. /! WARNING: The bath rug underlay should be clean, flat, and dry before placing the mat on the floor. Water or dust under mat may cause slippage.

[Easy to Clean]: This washable bathroom rug is easy to clean；simply toss it into the washing machine with gentle detergent on the gentle cycle and let air dry. With premium fiber locking technology, every fiber is firmly attached onto the backing so that the mat will not shed and sustains anti-slipping. Mats are tested and proved to withstand frequent machine washings and can still maintain shape.

[Enjoy the Comfort Feeling of Standing on The Clouds.] The premium well-constructed thick microfiber bathroom mat brings you a comfortable feeling to the touch like walking on the cloud. Perfect gift for your family and friends.
